title: 6 Day Canadian Rocky Mountains Explorer Private Tour
includes: Entrance fees to the Yoho, Banff, Jasper, Glacier, and Mount Revelstoke National Parks
Private tour, just you and your group
Insightful live commentary in English on board, tailored to your group's interest
Parks Canada shuttle between Lake Louise and Moraine Lake
Private transport by air-conditioned luxurious Mercedes Benz Sprinter van
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
A maximum of 11 guests per booking
Most lakes are still frozen in the month of May.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You will visit the wonders and beauty of the most spectacular sights in Jasper National Park, Banff National Park, Yoho National Park, Mt Revelstoke National Park, Glacier National Park in the Canadian Rockies, and Wells Gray Provincial Park. 

You will be awed by the size of the mountain ranges and peaks; the sheer beauty of its canyons, waterfalls, turquoise lakes; its mighty glaciers; and unique flora and fauna. You will visit Banff, Jasper, Athabasca Glacier, Lake Louise, Lake Moraine, Lake Peyto, Emerald Lake, Helmcken Falls, Takakkaw Falls, Natural Bridge, and Johnston Canyon. Enjoy wine tasting at Kamloops. Visit a dam in Revelstoke. From Kamloops to Merritt, enjoy 7 scenic lakes, desert physical landscape, and see unique flora and fauna.

NOTE: The Columbia Icefield Adventure (May-September), Maligne Lake Cruise (June - September), Revelstoke Dam (May-September)

You arrange your accommodation in Clearwater, Jasper, Banff, and Revelstoke. We can assist you with hotel guidance.
